text:
ben: Quick heads up — starting a staged bump of v2 on /generate in eu-west-1 at 09:00 PT. Plan: 5% -> 20% over 30m. This rollout flips the new SDK feature-flag header (`X-SDK-Compat: v2`) for mobile clients. Please watch latency and error rates. @priya can you confirm release notes are live?

deploy-bot: Deploy job started: service=gateway env=eu-west-1 version=v2-rollout-2026-03-20 stage=init

priya: Release notes published at https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2-rollout-2026-03-20 :white_check_mark: Added migration steps for SDKs and flag example.

alice: Noted. I pushed a quick alert to dashboards for 95p latency and 5xx spike, also added a query for `x-sdk-compat` header buckets. :eyes:

rafael: Started smoke tests from mobile lab — first 200 requests look fine (p50/p95 similar to v1). No schema diffs yet.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 5% -> 10% (09:06 PT)

alice: Seeing small uptick in 502s from a subset of mobile infra at 09:08. Trace ID sample: `trace-9a8b-c3`. Logs show `UpstreamProtocolError`. Investigating whether proxy strips `X-SDK-Compat`.

ops-rene: Also seeing a latency tail at 09:09 — p99 jumped to ~420ms on a handful of nodes. Error rate for user-agents matching `MobileClient/1.*` is +2.1% absolute. :rotating_light:

ben: Hold on further traffic. If errors continue >1m we should rollback. Rafael — can the mobile team toggle the SDK flag remotely?

rafael: Mobile remote flag system is rolling out, but takes ~3–5m to reach all clients. We can patch server-side to accept both header forms temporarily.

alice: Quick workaround added to gateway: accept `x-sdk-compat` lowercase and `X-SDK-Compat` variant, and treat unknown values as `v1` for safety. Pushed at 09:12.

deploy-bot: Hot config applied on 6/6 gateway pods (09:12 PT) — config-id=hotfix-2740001111-a

ben: Good quickfix. Ops — continue to watch for new 5xx counts for next 10m. If it spikes back above 1.5% rollback. 

ops-rene: After the patch p95/p99 trending back down, 5xx dropped to baseline within ~90s. Holding at 09:16.

priya: I'll add a short note to the release channel about the header normalization hotfix and that rollout will resume after 20m of stable metrics.

ben: Resume traffic at 09:20 — shift 10% -> 20% over 10m. Rafael, please confirm mobile flag propagation still in flight and we'll keep the server tolerant.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 10% -> 15% (09:21 PT)

alice: Observed a tiny blip in error traces at 09:23 but nothing sustained. p99 back to normal by 09:24.

rafael: Mobile flag propagation at ~60% of active clients now. Should hit 95% in ~8m.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 15% -> 20% (09:29 PT)

ben: OK — leaving rollout at 20% and schedule follow-up: 1) postmortem if any client SDKs show incompatibilities, 2) add header normalization upstream permanently, 3) update SDK sample to include fallback header casing. Priya, please prep a short rollback blurb in case we need it fast.

priya: Drafted blurb in #announcements/ops-digest and pinned it. Also added the rollback command snippet: `deploy-bot rollback service=gateway version=v1 target-traffic=100` in the runbook.

ops-rene: Marking thread resolved in 20m if metrics hold. For now everything stable. :white_check_mark:

ben: Thanks everyone — good catch on the header casing. We'll follow up in eng-all-hands with the compatibility checklist.

deploy-bot: Deploy job completed: status=successful end_time=09:31 PT notes="staged rollout to 20% with header-normalize hotfix"
